description: List published Community Days events with the events page's filters, no keyword needed: e.g. upcoming events with an open call for speakers, open registration or sponsorship, by cost, type or country. Upcoming soonest first; past most recent first.

call_for_speakers.description: true: only events whose call for speakers is open now

call_for_sponsors.description: true: only events whose call for sponsors is open now

cost.description: Comma-separated: free, low_cost ($30 or less), paid (more than $30)

country.description: Comma-separated two-letter country codes, e.g. us,ca,gb

from.description: With when=range: first start date, yyyy-MM-dd (leave out for no earliest date)

q.description: Optional keyword in the title, city or region (diacritic-insensitive)

registration_open.description: true: only events whose registration is open now

source.description: all (default), community_days (listed on Community Days) or external (copied from Microsoft's event listings; upcoming only, as past and range lists leave copied events out)

to.description: With when=range: last start date, yyyy-MM-dd (leave out for no latest date)

when.description: upcoming (default: not ended yet, so events under way today are included), past (already ended) or range (from, to or both)

name: list_events
